create.name: Kājalīgrāma
create.about: Birthplace of Śrīmatī Padmāvatī, Nityānanda Prabhu's mother, daughter of Śrī Maheśvara Śarmā.

create.name: Kālikāpura
create.about: The deities of Śrī Rādhā-Mādhava installed by the descendants of Śrī Gaṅgāmātā Gosvāminī are worshipped here.

create.name: Kāñcanā-grāma
create.about: Birthplace of the brothers Śrī Vāsudeva Datta and Śrī Mukunda Datta and of other associates of Mahāprabhu. Mahāprabhu asked Śivānanda Sena to look after Vāsudeva Datta's property.

create.name: Kāṅkuṭiyā
create.about: The house of the father-in-law of Śrī Locana dāsa Ṭhākura; the deities he installed, Śrī Gopīnātha and Śrī Gaura-Nitāī, are still worshipped.

create.name: Kāśima-bāzāra
create.about: The palace of Mahārāja Maṇīndracandra Nandī, who gave everything for Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava-dharma: he paid for a Bhāgavatam printed with several commentaries and helped Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura and Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura preach.

create.name: Kogrāma
create.about: The residence and samādhi of Śrī Locana dāsa Ṭhākura, author of the Caitanya-maṅgala, son of Kamalākara and Sadānandī and disciple of Narahari Sarakāra Ṭhākura.

create.name: Kolkata Bāgabāzāra
create.about: Śrī Madana-mohana, once served by Kāśīśvara Paṇḍita's descendants and then by King Vīra Hāmvīra of Viṣṇupura, was mortgaged by one of the king's descendants to the landowner Gokulacandra Mitra of Bāgabāzāra, and is still here in his house.

create.name: Kṛṣṇapura
create.location: A short distance south of Saptagrāma, on the east bank of the Sarasvatī (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Appearance-place of Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; the palace of his father Govardhana dāsa and uncle Hiraṇya dāsa was here. In the temple are his wooden shoes and the stone slab he sat on.

create.name: Kulāī
create.location: On the Ajaya river, ten miles north-west of Kaṭavā
create.about: Birthplace of three associates of Mahāprabhu, Śrī Govinda, Śrī Mādhava and Śrī Vāsudeva (Ghoṣa). Mahāprabhu rested on the bank of the river here.

create.name: Mādhāī-talā
create.location: One mile from Mahāprabhu's temple in Kaṭavā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: The samādhi of Śrī Mādhāī, of the brothers Jagāī and Mādhāī.

create.name: Maheśa
create.about: The residence of Mahāprabhu's associates Śrī Kamalākara Pippalāī and Dhruvānanda Brahmacārī. Kamalākara's daughter Nārāyaṇī-devī married Śrī Vīracandra Prabhu. Its Ratha-yātrā is renowned.

create.name: Mekhalā
create.about: The residence of Śrī Puṇḍarīka Vidyānidhi, disciple of Mādhavendra Purī, whom Mahāprabhu called «Father» and from whom Gadādhara Paṇḍita took initiation. He went to the Gaṅgā only at night, never putting his feet in her waters.

create.name: Nityānandapura
create.about: After Nityānanda Prabhu married Śrī Vasudhā and Śrī Jāhnavā-devī, they lived here for some time.

create.name: Pañcakuṭī
create.about: Here dacoits stole the bullock cart full of scriptures from Śrīnivāsa Ācārya.
